Third engraved Ave maris stella (H.I) 'In memoriis' = gregobase:14959 'Ave Maris Stella (Off. BMV in Sab.)' (Solesmes 1960, Liber antiphonarius p.[126]; the only chant on the LH index row 5161 for p260). It is a DIFFERENT melody from p258's 8878 (In Solemnitatibus): 8878 starts A(d)ve(hi) ma(g)ris(hi) stel(k)la(jvIHGh.) with neumes; 14959 is simple, mostly single notes with the same flat/hi start (A(d)VE(ixhi) ma(h)ris(g') stel(h)la(g.)), matching the sparse, repeated-note p260 engraving. No LH-1983 gregobase edition of this melody exists; index linked it resolved_with_difficulty (best available). Judgement link, flagged for review.
Hymn runs p260-p262; p262 has only stanza 7 + Amen, no trailing vel/Ad libitum line.
